detail.longDescription: Hope everyone had a good halloween! I definitely got quite a shock seeing there are over 1000 Catima Wear OS users! For those people, Catima 1.1.0 for Wear OS is now out, a non-scary update ;) This little Wear OS companion apps allows you to see your Catima cards on your Wear OS smartwatch. https:// github.com/CatimaLoyalty/Andro id/releases/tag/v1.1.0-wearos This new version adds support for swiping on the card display screen to see more card details. Coming soon to an app store near you! # Catima # WearOS # FDroid # GitHub # GooglePlay
